bullets.text: Led the redesign of the **order-processing service** (Go, **Kafka**, PostgreSQL), cutting **p99 latency from 1.2s to 180ms** and handling **3x peak traffic** during seasonal sales without new hardware.
Built an **LLM-powered support triage pipeline** with retrieval over 40K help articles and an **offline evaluation harness**, routing **62% of tickets** automatically at **95% precision**.
Introduced **SLO-based alerting** with Prometheus and Grafana across 14 services, reducing pager noise by **70%** and mean time to recovery from 48 to **12 minutes**.
Mentored **4 engineers** and ran the backend design-review forum, standardising API versioning and idempotency patterns.
Developed a **multi-tenant reporting API** (Python, **FastAPI**, Elasticsearch) serving **2M+ queries/day** for 300 enterprise customers, with per-tenant rate limits, caching and audit logging.
Migrated nightly batch ETL to **event-driven ingestion** on AWS Lambda and S3, cutting data freshness from 24 hours to **under 5 minutes** and removing a 6-hour maintenance window.
Cut monthly **AWS spend by $18K** through right-sizing RDS instances, S3 lifecycle policies and reserved capacity.
Wrote internal tooling for schema migrations that eliminated manual release steps.
Built a **feature-flag service** (Django, **Redis**) adopted by 6 product teams, enabling gradual rollouts and instant kill switches.
Added **contract tests** to the payments client, catching 9 breaking changes before release.
